features: The English Springer Spaniel Measures 4" X 3 1/4"
The English Springer Spaniel Shape Cookie Cutter is made from solid heavyweight copper, jointed using lead free solder
Perfect English Springer Spaniel gift idea, make English Springer Spaniel cookies, treats and crafts, great breeder gift too!
Made in the USA the Copper English Springer Spaniel cookie cutter is built for years of use. It also looks good hanging on a tree as an ornament. English Springer Spaniel Silhouette
description: Looking for a treat for a dog loving friend? Why not bake up a batch of English Springer Spaniel cookies! Don't feel like baking ~ these make great gifts too. Who wouldn't love a dog cookie cutter from a friend! Each cookie cutter is hand crafted in our workshop from heavy weight solid copper. This cookie cutter is built to last for many generations of cookie baking, fondant cutting, ornament making, or even use it for tracing quilt patterns. We're a small family business with a passion for creating cookie cutters. We sign each of our cookie cutters with a little makers mark ~ nothing fancy just a hand engraved mark from one of our cookie cutter makers. Made from very heavy weight copper to maintain shape while using and storing. Great for gift giving or as a centerpiece to a cookie bouquet! Each one is slightly different from the next as they are formed one at a time and hand soldered using lead-free silver solder. Listing is for one cookie cutter.
